title: State machines on an enum field
why: Order or ticket statuses change only through declared transitions with guards, roles and side effects, so invalid jumps are impossible.
changelog: `transitions.jsbrain` turns one `enum` field into a state machine

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export default {
  field: 'status',
  initial: ['pending'],
  transitions: { pay: { from: ['pending'], to: 'paid', roles: ['owner'] } }
}
